submission.justification: Mixture-G1 at a 2 mm gap gave the best simulated time resolution, 0.932 ns. At 1 mm and 3 mm it gave 1.047 ns and 1.038 ns. G2 reached 1.371 ns at best and G3 reached 2.18 ns at 1 mm. The ranking G1 < G2 < G3 holds at every gap I simulated, and the 2 mm results match the 2025 summary. CAVEAT: no environmental or safety policy document is in the project files. I could not check whether G1, the standard fluorinated mixture, complies, and fluorinated gases are often restricted. The recirculation system (90% recovery) and the HV supplies (up to 12 kV, compatible with all mixtures) are documented, but neither shows policy compliance. The collaboration must confirm compliance before committing. If G1 is not allowed, the next choice is G2 at 2 mm (1.371 ns).

requirements.evidence: G1 at 2 mm gave 0.932 ns, the lowest of all simulated mixture and gap combinations (G1 1 mm 1.047, 3 mm 1.038; G2 1.408, 1.371, 1.538 at 1, 2, 3 mm; G3 2.182 at 1 mm). G3 was simulated at 1 mm only, and the 2025 summary gives 2.0 ns at 2 mm.
